name: career-alpha
description: AI-native career OS for trend discovery, asymmetric opportunity finding, proof-of-work, evidence-backed positioning, interview defense and market feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Find asymmetric career opportunities and turn them into verifiable proof.
interface.longDescription: Career Alpha packages radar, wedge, contributor, build, proof, position, interview and offer as eight TraeWork skills in one evidence-first career operating system.
defaultPrompt: Use /radar to scan emerging career opportunities.
Use /wedge to find an asymmetric entry point.
Use /contributor to build verified open-source evidence.
Use /build to design a proof-of-work mission.
Use /proof to build a Claim–Evidence Ledger.
Use /position to create Safe, Strong and Future positioning.
Use /offer to close the loop with market feedback.
